description:
## Functional specifications and files
Store folder configuration on canonical source identity; resolve applicable inherited/manual/pending/excluded labels deterministically with origin. Descendant reads and edits reflect folder changes and moves without duplicate evaluation or independent ancestry tree; cleanup deletions/tombstones. Persist explicit document overrides/exclusions.
Files/owners: Labels owning domain, existing Storage EntryCatalog / Channels Records ancestry contracts, relevant ingestion lifecycle/read projections.
## Tests to add before implementation
Extend shared assignment/integration tests for nested precedence, override/exclusion, origin visibility, folder edits/moves/deletion, new descendants, source isolation and permission denial. Property tests deterministic resolution/idempotency.
## Branches/paths validated
Success, invalid input, nil/denied actor, stale/concurrent write, unavailable/deleted source, lifecycle cleanup and failure rollback where relevant. No hidden cross-service calls.
## Mocking plan
Real Repo, validated Actions, NodeRouter and domain boundaries. Mock only external provider/conversion HTTP when relevant; runtime dependencies via existing Zaq.Config opts, no global mutation.
## Documentation
Update owner module docs and relevant existing service/BO guide alongside behavior; durable evidence here. Follow docs/documentation.md.
## Action reuse assessment
Extend existing EditResourceLabels and resource projections for folder scope; domain-local inheritance uses canonical source hierarchy. Folder resource is configuration scope, not definition Document/Chunk applicability. Preserve read/write actor checks and versioned atomic writes.
## Validation/dependencies
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/code-quality.md and applicable service guides. Scoped tests + mix q only per implementation issue. Final precommit reserved for final child. Supervisor verifies before closure. New feature E2E remains zaq-kw0.15 -> zaq-kw0.16.
title: [zaq-kw0.44.4] Implement folder labels and effective inheritance
